title: Prof. Helen Lee 李雪玟教授
content_html:
Helen Lee 李雪玟, Soprano, is a faculty member in the Music Department at the University of Nevada, Reno. In May 2006 she received the Dean’s Award for Excellence in Teaching, and has served as president of the university’s international faculty honor society, receiving special recognition at the World Congress held in Montreal, Canada. She is frequently invited to sing the American national anthem at important events in Nevada and California, representing Taiwanese Americans with distinction. Professor Lee has performed successfully several times at Carnegie Hall and Lincoln Center in New York City. She was invited by the Suzuki Music Association of Japan to tour Japan, where she was interviewed and performed on Japanese television.

Professor Lee was born in Pingtung, Taiwan, into a family prominent in banking and finance. An outstanding student, she frequently represented her school in academic and artistic competitions, often winning prizes. After advancing directly from Pingtung Girls’ Senior High School, she won first place in the Pingtung County Vocal Competition and subsequently won again in the National Solo Singing Competition. While studying in the Music Department of Chinese Culture University, she was recognized by Professor Robert Scholz, sent to Taiwan by the U.S. State Department, who frequently cast her in the leading soprano roles under his direction; she also recorded the first classical music world masterworks album in Taiwan for Happiness Records. Her love of literature led her to win a national essay competition. In her senior year she received a teaching assistantship scholarship from Brigham Young University and went to the United States to pursue advanced studies.

She is the first Taiwanese soprano to win an award in the Metropolitan Opera Auditions. Professor Lee performed live on a television special for two-time Olympic gold medalist German figure skating champion Katarina Witt, singing her skating music during a live broadcast that was transmitted worldwide. At the invitation of the Taipei Philharmonic Foundation, she returned to her beloved homeland and gave a deeply moving concert at the National Concert Hall. She also returned to National Taiwan Normal University as an exchange professor for short-term teaching and concert tours. Wherever she goes, she encourages love for the beautiful island of Taiwan and seizes every opportunity to strengthen Taiwanese people’s confidence and dignity. In June 2007, the North American Taiwanese Professors’ Association (NATPA) presented a special award to Helen Lee for her contributions to Taiwan and Taiwanese Americans. In March of the same year she returned to Taiwan to perform at the FAPA 25th Anniversary Conference, sharing the stage with President Chen Shui-bian and Vice President Annette Lu.

聲樂家李雪玟任教於內華達大學(University of Nevada, Reno)音樂系。2006年五月榮獲傑出教學獎，擔任過該校國際教授榮譽學會的會長，在加拿大蒙特利奧舉行的世界大會中接受到特別傑出的表揚。經常被邀請到內華達州及加州的重要節目場合代表獻唱美國國歌，為台美人爭光。李雪玟在紐約巿的卡內基廳(Carnegie Hall)及林肯藝術表演中心(Lincoln Center)有數度成功的演唱，曾應日本鈴木音樂社的邀請赴日本作巡迴演唱，在日本電視上接受訪問及表演。

李雪玟教授生於台灣屏東金融世家。從小成績優異，經常代表學校參加各種學術及藝術比賽，經常得獎。在屏東女中直升高中後，即獲屏東縣聲樂比賽冠軍，隨即參加全國獨唱比賽，再度得獎。在就讀文化大學音樂系時，受到美國國務院派遣台灣的蕭滋教授的賞識，經常在他指揮下，擔任最重要的女高音角色，並為幸福唱片灌了全台灣第一張古典音樂的世界名曲集。李雪玟對文學寫作的熱愛，曾在一次全國徵文比賽中獲獎。大四時，即獲美國楊氏大學Brigham Young University 助教獎學金，隨即赴美深造。

她是首位在美國大都會歌劇院選拔賽獲獎的台灣人女高音，李教授曾為兩度奧運金牌的德籍女花式溜冰冠軍卡大莉娜在拍攝電視特別表演，在當場實況轉播時，為她演唱她的溜冰曲，該節目全球皆有轉播。她也在台北愛樂基金會的邀請下，回到她熱愛的鄉土，於國家音樂廳舉辦了令觀眾感動的音樂會，並曾以交換教授回台灣師範大學作短期教學與巡迴演唱。她所到之處，皆盡量鼓勵大家對美麗寶島的真愛，並把握每個機會來增強台灣人的自信與尊嚴。2007年六月北美洲台灣人教授協會特別頒獎給李雪玟，因她對台灣及台美人的貢獻。同年三月FAPA25週年慶典特地回台演唱，與陳水扁總統、呂秀蓮副總統同台。
